reason: After comprehensive review of Rolls-Royce Holdings plc 2024 Annual Report (including Strategic Report, divisional reviews, CEO review, and financial sections), no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company itself. The document contains extensive discussion of strategy, markets, revenues, growth targets, and mid-term financial goals, but does not provide specific TAM estimates for any business segment. The company discusses market opportunities (e.g., AUKUS, SMR deployment, Civil Aerospace orders) qualitatively but does not quantify addressable market sizes in monetary terms or provide market sizing data from any source.
